reason: The lifetime option is the only plan I'd even look at, but $99 for something I'd fire up three or four times a year is steep, and the free tier will probably cover a small client site when I actually need one. I've bought lots of lifetime deals in the $39-$69 range and I'd wait for this one to land there.
objection: It's brand new with zero reviews, and I've been burned by lifetime deals from startups that shut down or quietly cut features a year later. Paying $99 upfront to an unknown is a lot of trust.
would_change_my_mind: A launch lifetime deal around $49-$59 with real reviews from other agency people, or a client project landing that week where I need all devices on a 100-page site.
